findings.current: The more than twenty horsemen stopped where they stood as if on cue.
findings.defect: “More than twenty” asserts a number above twenty, while 이십여 기 means about twenty. The same quantity is rendered as “Some twenty” earlier in the scene.
findings.rationale: The Korean repeats 이십여 기; the English should preserve the approximate quantity consistently rather than make the second mention a definite lower bound.
findings.replacement: The twenty-odd horsemen stopped where they stood as if on cue.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful. One repeated quantity is rendered more narrowly than the Korean supports.
